description: Returns the origin countries that have their own table in the official CBAM default-values act, as ISO code and name, with the regulation source. Use it to pick a country code before calling cbam_get_default_values; it returns no emission values itself, and countries not listed use OTHER there. No inputs. Output: countries[] (code, name) and source. Changes only when the bundled official act is updated. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free, as short samples (up to 3 records, without file proof, history or paging cursor) where a paid HTTP address exists (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors are free, and so are empty answers except a sanctions name search with no match when every loaded list it checks is fresh (lists not loaded yet are named in the answer). An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.
name: cbam_list_countries
title: List CBAM default-value countries
